business_summary: Guangzheng Eye Hospital Group Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides ophthalmological medical services through its hospitals in China. It operates through Steel Structure Sector, Energy, and Medical and Health segments. The company offers diagnosis and treatment of various eye diseases, including refractive surgery, cataract surgery, optometry, and comprehensive eye surgery. It also engages in the processing, fabrication, sale, and installation of steel structures; gas station leasing; and oil and natural gas sales and home installation. In addition, the company is involved in consulting services; technology promotion and application services; investment in natural gas refueling station projects; sale of petroleum products; gas production and supply; specialized equipment manufacturing; medical management; medical devices; Internet and related services; medical information maintenance; medical information consulting; operation of gas and CNG stations; and road transport activities. The company was formerly known as Guangzheng Group Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Guangzheng Eye Hospital Group Co.,Ltd. in October 2020. Guangzheng Eye Hospital Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
